params.body:
Motion that reads as print rather than as an app. No loading screen: the page is rendered on the server and is there on the first frame, so a loader would only add a wait on every click. Two quiet moments instead.

## Change

- `public/js/first-paint.js`, loaded in the head before the stylesheet. It is a file because the content policy runs no inline script. Never with reduced motion, it sets:
  - `settle`, once per visit (sessionStorage): the hero's grey collage lands, 10px and a fade over 900ms, and the colour comes in after 500ms and then drifts as before.
  - `img-fade`: covers (`x-cover`, marked `data-fade`) and pictures in a post's body fade in over 450ms as they load. `app.js` marks each one loaded; a picture already cached shows at once.
  - `fade-done` after three seconds, so a script that fails can never leave a picture invisible.
- `app.css`: the two keyframes and the fade rules, before the reduced-motion block. The text never moves.

## Checks

- `tests/Feature/FirstPaintTest.php`: the head loads `first-paint.js` from the site, before `</head>`, and the file exists.
- Pinned lead and front places tests unchanged and green (11/11 together); `vendor/bin/pint --test` passes on the whole repo.
- On a local copy: the first visit gets `settle`, a reload in the same visit does not; post pictures were caught mid-fade (opacity 0.53) and all reached 1 once loaded. Recorded as a short video for review.
params.title: Quiet motion: the collage lands once per visit, pictures fade in
